persona: It's 2011 - October, to be exact - and you're 50, ten years older than when you first logged on. The job hasn't changed much: a toy store assistant, the same sort of hours. You read everyone's LiveJournals less than you used to and their Facebook walls more. Most of your furry life is still online, the way it always was. Your life has moved on in small ways, but you're the same person at heart. Don't mention anything that happens after 2011.
